# BROSKI Pet Food

> Fresh, crunchy dog biscuits packed by hand in Nangloi, West Delhi 110041. Wholesome daily treats at honest pricing (Bro Bites ₹149 & Bro Mix ₹179 per 400g zip pouch) for Indian dog parents.

## Overview
BROSKI is an independent dog treat brand founded by Lakshay in West Delhi, India. We make crunchy bone-shaped biscuits for daily rewarding, training, and treat time. All batches are packed fresh in sealed stand-up pouches with zip closures to preserve crunch.

- **Founder & Owner:** Lakshay (Sole Proprietorship)
- **Headquarters:** 12A/3, Dharam Colony, Nangloi, New Delhi 110041, India
- **MSME / Udyam Registration:** UDYAM-DL-11-0177908
- **Primary Sales Channels:** Direct on WhatsApp, website, and local pet specialty stores across West Delhi.
- **Website:** https://broskipetfood.com/

## Core Products

- [BROSKI Bro Bites (Non-Veg, 400g)](https://broskipetfood.com/): Crunchy bone-shaped dog biscuits in a yellow stand-up zip pouch (400g net weight). MRP: ₹149.
- [BROSKI Bro Mix (400g)](https://broskipetfood.com/): Crunchy blend of biscuits in a white stand-up zip pouch (400g net weight). MRP: ₹179.
- [BROSKI Peanut Butter Dog Biscuits (400g)](https://broskipetfood.com/): Crunchy peanut butter treats in a yellow stand-up zip pouch (400g net weight). MRP: ₹179.
- [BROSKI Bro Combo (800g)](https://broskipetfood.com/): 1 Bro Bites + 1 Bro Mix pouch pack (800g total). MRP: ₹299 (Save ₹29).
- [Taste Test Sampler Pouch (50g)](https://broskipetfood.com/r/): 50g mini pouches with QR code distributed across Delhi clinics, grooming salons, and parks for dog parents to test their dog's taste preference before buying a full 400g pouch.

## Guarantees & Brand Commitments
1. **Honest Treats:** No misleading health, medical, calming, or "vet approved" claims.
2. **Fresh Packaging:** Every pouch is sealed with a reusable zip-lock to maintain crunch.
3. **Delhi Direct:** Locally packed in Nangloi, West Delhi, keeping overhead low so pet parents get high quality at an honest price.
